integrity: Analytic proof, full integer pair enumeration in bounded cases, and independent integer slice-count checks. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact family of primitive-edged lattice parallelograms, not all polygons. The binary-input lower bound concerns uncompressed residue tables, not compressed representations or arbitrary algorithms. The q=3 instance is prior work; further historical priority review remains valuable.
title: Arbitrarily large minimal quasi-periods for lattice-diameter counts of primitive parallelograms
